notes.title: The release of Sushi Battle Rambunctiously has been postponed to 2024.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641043/3345313775698387db25e23883aa4f452b120177.png[/img]

Howdy! This is the 'Sushi Battle Rambunctiously' team.

We are very grateful for your interest in our game. While the release date for Sushi Battle Rambunctiously was initially set for October, we have decided to internally work on improvements and enhancements to provide you with a better game. As a result, we regret to inform you that the release date for Sushi Battle Rambunctiously will be postponed to March 2024.

We apologize for not being able to keep our promise to you and look forward to delivering a better game in the future. Thank you for your understanding.
